title: Fixed Open-Feed Twin-Roll Crusher
description: One original complete static ore-processing machine appearance with a broad open feed hopper, two transverse solid rolls opposed across a real narrow central gap, and a separate open tapered discharge funnel below. Each whole roll has integral stepped shoulders and two solid journals seated in four actual bored bearing bodies. Two grounded inverted-U end frames carry the bearings, four short hopper stanchions and the discharge flange. Fourteen closed editable meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials. The whole upper-feed / opposed-roll nip / lower-outlet arrangement is the structural distinction: not just two cylinders, old corrugated V jaws made round, more vertical stamps, or a twin-helical robot with its body removed. No imported old geometry, hopper payload, motor, gear train, guards, belt, particles or separately counted parts. One whole prop, no scene. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, complete horizontal bounds centred and actual four foot soles at Z0. Static art only: no working rotation, synchronization, crushing, material feed, product size, throughput, machinery compatibility, maintenance access, manufacture, installation, structural loading, workplace protection or safety claim. Visible exposed fixed parts are not a safe real-machine design or instructions.
